workLog.detail: Confirmed .github/workflows/validate-generated-agents.yml:158 runs build_all.py --check and that scripts/validation/pre_pr_sequence.py:171 only passes build_all.py as a path to validate_no_orphaned_build_deferrals, which reads deferral comments in that file's source. Different question, so the local sequence never asked whether generated output was stale.

lefthook.yml:565 already runs build-all-check at pre-push with no glob filter, so the gap is specific to pre_pr.py. That matters because AGENTS.md and .claude/rules/ci-scripts.md MUST 2 both name pre_pr.py as the gate to run before opening a PR, and PR #5059 was reported ready on pre_pr evidence before the push.

.claude/rules/generated-artifacts.md requires sync_plugin_lib.py before build_all.py. The new gate runs sync_plugin_lib.py --check then build_all.py --check and stops at the first failure. Both are read-only, so REQ-003-010 holds and no generator writes under .claude/. Did not make build_all invoke the sync.

build_all.py --check alone: 4.43s standalone. Both checks together: 3.63s standalone cold, 1.29s inside the pre_pr sequence. Full pre_pr: 304.63s over 54 validations, so the gate is roughly 0.4 percent of the run. No changed-paths filter needed; build_all --check is a whole-tree question and a path filter would manufacture a green tick.

First draft echoed the head of the child output, which showed generator progress and dropped the STALENESS DETECTED block that names the drifted files. Changed to a tail echo, and only on failure so a clean run adds one line to pre_pr output.

The first test draft carried three '# type: ignore' comments and tripped type_ignore_count_ratchet at 47 against baseline 44. Replaced the manual rebind with monkeypatch.setattr and typed the callback parameter as Callable[[], bool]. Count back to 44; the baseline was not raised.

nextSteps: build/scripts/build_all.py:1206 prints an em dash in its STALENESS DETECTED message, which .claude/rules/universal.md MUST NOT 5 forbids in authored text. The dash validator scans markdown only, so nothing catches it. Left alone to keep this diff scoped.
